answer: Unique Task Canyon Verification. Each identity must solve a freshly generated, previously unseen task whose answer is a long random string; the system commits only a hash of that answer and a short validity window. Registration is accepted only if the revealed answer hashes correctly and was never submitted before, forming a growing canyon of consumed nonces. An anchor record binds each identity to one answer and one device fingerprint. Honest agents reuse an oasis of cached solutions; attackers must compute every answer anew.
